test_title: PYST 30: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Consensus
solution:
The correct answer is '**Agreement'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Consensus **means a general agreement among a group of people. (लोगों के एक समूह के बीच एक सामान्य समझौता)
 
• Agreement is a **synonym **of consensus.
 
• **Agreement **means a mutual understanding, consensus, or harmony between two or more parties regarding a particular matter, decision, or contract. (किसी विशेष मामले, निर्णय या अनुबंध के संबंध में दो या दो से अधिक पक्षों के बीच आपसी समझ, आम सहमति या सामंजस्य)
 
• Grammatically, both words are nouns.
 
 
• **Example**: *After hours of debate, the committee finally reached a consensus/agreement on the proposed policy.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Census **means an official count or survey of a population. (किसी जनसंख्या की आधिकारिक गणना या सर्वेक्षण)
 
• **Censure **means to express severe disapproval or criticism towards someone/something. (किसी व्यक्ति/वस्तु के प्रति गंभीर अस्वीकृति या आलोचना व्यक्त करना)
 
• **Puck **is a small, hard rubber disk used in ice hockey. (आइस हॉकी में उपयोग की जाने वाली एक छोटी, कठोर रबर डिस्क)
